name: Larpcord
description: Larpcord is a open source discord client thats specializedon faking or "larping" many settings. You can tweak almost everything, how you want.

paragraphs: The Discord client where you can be anyone. At least on your own screen.

Larpcord is an open-source, standalone Discord client (its own .exe) that lets you give yourself badges, the Nitro look, avatar decorations, profile effects, server badges, a different name and your own layout – locally. Everything Larpcord changes is visible only on your PC. Nobody else sees it, and your account is never changed.
Larp (Live Action Role Play): pretending. That's exactly what Larpcord does.
features: All official badges, locally: Discord Staff, Partner, HypeSquad (Events, Bravery, Brilliance, Balance), Early Supporter, Bug Hunter (level 1 & 2), Active Developer, Moderator Alumni, Early Verified Bot Developer
Custom badges with your own image (PNG/GIF/SVG) and tooltip text
Your own clan tag next to your name
Nitro badge with any subscription length (including boost badge tiers)

whatItDoes.text: The Discord client where you can be anyone. At least on your own screen.

requirements.text: Log in with your Discord account and get started under Settings → Larpcord
